name: Computer Use Turbo
description: Faster, cheaper GUI sessions: a countable handoff budget removes the whole detour, and redundant or byte-identical screenshots stop being billed.

config.enabled: Master switch. When off, no listener is registered.
config.presets: Agent preset ids this applies to; empty means every session.
config.policy: Replace the shipped computer-use policy with a compressed one (the coordinate clause is kept verbatim).
config.discipline: Append a short working discipline (no narration, no re-reading an image, stop when done).
config.dedupeImages: Replace a byte-identical screenshot with a one-line equivalent notice.
config.strictImageDedupe: Require a SHA-256 byte comparison; when bytes are unavailable, skip dedupe instead of guessing.
config.dedupeText: Replace a verbatim-identical non-observation text result with an equivalent notice.
config.textDedupeMinChars: Minimum code points before text dedupe applies.
config.textCapHeadChars: Head budget in code points; 0 with the tail at 0 disables capping (lossy, off by default).
config.imageRetentionWindow: Keep only the newest N screenshots and replace older ones with a notice; 0 keeps every one.
config.logSavings: Write the savings report to the Host log.
config.verboseMetrics: Include the per-metric breakdown in the log.
